summary: Climber on Ellingwood Point separated from his party and unable to descend, dehydrated and hallucinating; AVSAR callout with Flight For Life (Life Guard 4 from Canon City) to fly in the team; another hiker climbed to him and gave water and food; AVSAR members met the party and walked the subject down to Lake Como; clear of the mountain by late evening
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR; Flight For Life
notes: AVSAR 2012 archive narrative; subject among a party of four young men from China, language barrier noted; no landing zone for helo near subject
